skills.name: analyze-spending
skills.description: Use when the user asks to categorize spending, group by merchant or category, rank top merchants, or show monthly trends on converted statements. Do not use for first-time PDF conversion, period reconciliation, or benchmark scoring.
skills.description_zh: 对已转换的银行对账单按商户或类别归集支出、列出主要商户并分析月度趋势；不用于首次转换、期间对账或基准评分。

skills.name: benchmark-accuracy
skills.description: Use when the user asks to convert and score a published Bankstatemently benchmark statement. Do not use for ordinary user-statement conversion, spending analysis, or reconciliation.
skills.description_zh: 转换 Bankstatemently 已公布的基准测试账单并对结果评分；不用于日常账单转换、支出分析或对账。

skills.name: convert-statement
skills.description: Use when the user attaches a bank statement PDF or asks for CSV/XLSX/QBO/Xero export of a converted statement. Do not use for spending analysis, reconciliation, or benchmark scoring — those have their own skills.
skills.description_zh: 将银行对账单 PDF 转换为数据，或将已转换结果导出为 CSV、XLSX、QBO、Xero 格式；其他分析任务使用对应 skills。

skills.name: reconcile-statements
skills.description: Use when the user asks to check statement coverage, missing periods, balance continuity, or cross-account transfers. Do not use for converting a new PDF, spending categorization, or benchmark scoring.
skills.description_zh: 检查对账单覆盖的期间、缺失期间、余额连续性和跨账户转账；不用于新 PDF 转换、支出分类或基准评分。
